SAFARI：扩展长期代理故障归因SAFARI: Scaling Long Horizon Agentic Fault Attribution
通过积极调查via Active Investigation

Chenyang Zhu    Jiayu Yao    Kushal Chawla    Youbing Yin    Nathan Wolfe    Pengshan Cai    Jingyu Wu    Spencer Hong    Sangwoo Cho    Shi-Xiong Zhang    Daben Liu    Sambit Sahu    Erin Babinsky
摘要Abstract

随着自主代理处理日益复杂的多步骤、多代理任务，它们的执行轨迹已经超出了最大上下文窗口的限制。当前有效诊断代理故障的方法将完整的轨迹加载到法学硕士的上下文窗口中，该窗口会受到注意力稀释的影响，并且当代理跟踪不可避免地超出上下文限制时会失败。为了解决这个问题，我们引入As autonomous agents tackle increasingly complex multi-step, multi-agent tasks, their execution trajectories have scaled beyond the constraints of even the largest context windows. Current methods for effectively diagnosing agent failures load the full trajectory into an LLM’s context window, which suffers from attention dilution and fails when agentic traces inevitably exceed context limits. To address this, we introduce萨法里SAFARI (S长远视野caling long-horizonA遗传性的genticF奥特aultAttR通过主动启动ibution via activeInvestigation），一个用工具增强的诊断循环代替线性上下文加载的框架。通过为法学硕士配备专门的工具箱nvestigation), a framework that replaces linear context loading with a tool-augmented diagnostic loop. By equipping LLMs with a specialized toolbox to读read和and搜索searchSAFARI 将轨迹段与用于交叉转弯推理的持久短期记忆 (STM) 结合在一起，有效地将诊断准确性与架构上下文限制分离。我们的实验表明trajectory segments alongside a persistent Short-Term Memory (STM) for cross-turn reasoning, SAFARI effectively decouples diagnostic accuracy from architectural context limits. Our experiments demonstrate that萨法里SAFARI在 100 万代币预算内，在 Who&When 数据集上比最新结果高出 20%，在 25K 代币预算内，在 TRAIL GAIA 子集上比最新结果高出 19%。最重要的是，outperforms state-of-the-art results by 20% on the Who&When dataset within a 1M token budget, and by 19% on TRAIL GAIA subset on a 25K token budget. Most significantly,萨法里SAFARI即使目标故障超出模型本机上下文窗口 5 倍（传统评估器完全失败的情况），也能保持 0.58 的精度。maintains a 0.58 precision even when the target fault resides 5x beyond the model’s native context window, a scenario where traditional evaluators fail entirely.

机器学习、ICMLMachine Learning, ICML

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的代理系统的快速发展使得日益复杂的任务实现自动化。随着这些系统向多代理协调扩展，诊断这些系统在何处以及如何发生故障变得相应重要The rapid advancement of Large Language Model (LLM)-driven agentic systems has enabled the automation of increasingly complex tasks. As these systems scale toward multi-agent coordination, it becomes correspondingly important to diagnose where and how these systems fail(Cemri et al., 2025)。故障归因是隔离导致故障轨迹的特定代理或步骤的任务，对于系统监控和可靠性至关重要。. Fault attribution, the task of isolating the specific agent or step responsible for a failed trajectory, is essential for system monitoring and reliability.

在故障归因领域，人类注释和单法学硕士法官显然无法准确有效地检测多智能体系统中的故障Within the field of fault attribution, it has become evident that human annotation and single-LLM judges are unable to accurately and efficiently detect faults in multi-agent systems(Zhang et al., 2025)。在过去的一年里，引入了两类故障归因能力：（a）基于模拟的方法，运行部分或整个轨迹来定位故障. Over the past year, two classes of fault attribution capabilities have been introduced: (a) simulation-based methods that run partial or entire trajectories to locate faults(Zhu et al., 2025; Epperson et al., 2025; Ge et al., 2025); (b) 利用多代理调用、迭代循环和工具调用的免模拟方法; and (b) simulation-free methods that leverage multi-agent invocations, iterative loops, and tool calls(Zhu et al., 2026; Yu et al., 2025).

然而，最先进的故障检测器在长期正确识别故障方面仍然面临挑战。迄今为止，故障检测系统在 Who&When 方面的性能显着下降However, challenges remain for state-of-the-art fault detectors to correctly identify faults over long horizons. To date, fault detection systems show notable drops in performance on the Who&When(Zhang et al., 2025)和踪迹and TRAIL(Deshpande et al., 2025)轨迹长度增加时的基准benchmarks when trajectory lengths increase(Zhu et al., 2026; Deshpande et al., 2025)。特别是在 TRAIL 中，代理轨迹的令牌长度已达到数百万个令牌，远远超过了开源和专有大型语言模型的上下文窗口。考虑到当前系统的局限性，引入能够经济有效地扩展以满足这些新要求的故障检测器解决方案非常重要。. In TRAIL particularly, the token lengths of agentic trajectories have reached multiple millions of tokens, well exceeding the context windows of open-source and proprietary large language models. Given the limitations of current systems, it is important to introduce fault detector solutions that can scale, cost-effectively, to these new requirements.

当前处理长期视野的策略包括利用基于代理反射的推理Current strategies for handling long horizons include utilizing agentic reflection-based reasoning(Zhu et al., 2026)和大量 1M 代币上下文窗口and massive 1M-token context windows(Deshpande et al., 2025; Zhu et al., 2025)。然而，这些方法的局限性在于它们被动地处理整个轨迹以进行故障检测。最近的文献表明，相反，主动调查（即战略性地存储和检索关键信息）可以优于将整个上下文作为长期任务的输入。 AgentFold 等框架. However, these approaches have the limitation that they process entire trajectories passively for fault detection. Recent literature reveals that, instead, active investigation (i.e. strategically storing and retrieving key information) can outperform ingesting the entire context as input for for long-horizon tasks. Frameworks like AgentFold(Ye et al., 2025)和光and LIGHT(Tavakoli et al., 2025)通过使用明确的读写技能来证明这一点，以确保关键细节在海量信息存储中保持可操作性。demonstrate this by using explicit read-write skills to ensure critical details remain actionable within massive information stores.

我们建议We propose萨法里SAFARI，一个完全自主的主动调查器，旨在通过迭代、假设驱动的探索来定位代理痕迹中的错误。与被动摄取整个轨迹的传统模型不同，, a fully autonomous Active Investigator designed to localize errors within agentic traces through iterative, hypothesis-driven exploration. Unlike traditional models that passively ingest entire trajectories,萨法里SAFARI通过生成原子假设、部署专门的搜索工具以及综合专家判断来验证自己的发现，动态地与轨迹进行交互。我们评估dynamically interacts with the trace by generating atomic hypotheses, deploying specialized search tools, and synthesizing expert judges to verify its own findings. We evaluate萨法里SAFARI跨越两个主要基准：谁和何时across two major benchmarks: Who&When(Zhang et al., 2025)和踪迹and TRAIL(Deshpande et al., 2025)，提供不同范围内故障归因的整体评估。我们的结果表明, providing a holistic assessment of fault attribution across varying horizons. Our results demonstrate that萨法里SAFARI在资源受限的环境中显着优于现有方法，有效地识别超出当前大型语言模型的本地上下文限制的故障。significantly outperforms existing methods in resource-constrained environments, effectively identifying faults that reside beyond the native context limits of current large language models.

3 实验装置Experimental Setup

数据集。Datasets.我们评估We evaluate萨法里SAFARI跨越两个不同的基准，代表不同的轨迹规模和不同的现实世界任务（表across two distinct benchmarks representing varied trajectory scales and diverse real-world tasks (Table1). 谁&何时Who&When包含来自 Magentic-One 的痕迹comprises traces from Magentic-One(Fourney et al., 2024)（算法生成的子集）和 CaptainAgent(the Algorithm-Generated subset) and CaptainAgent(Song et al., 2024)（手工制作的子集），源自 GAIA(the Hand-crafted subset), derived from GAIA(Mialon et al., 2023)和助理替补席and AssistantBench(Yoran et al., 2024)。与算法生成的子集相比，手工制作的子集具有明显更长的轨迹复杂性以及更多的代理步骤和标记。. Compared to the Algorithm-Generated subset, the Hand-crafted subset features significantly longer trajectory complexity with more agentic steps and tokens.踪迹TRAIL (Deshpande et al., 2025)提供长视野代理轨迹，一些轨迹超过 2M 令牌。这两个数据集带来了互补的挑战：尽管步数较少，但 TRAIL/SWE-bench 仍然是令牌密集的，而 TRAIL/GAIA 包含最长的轨迹，峰值为 122 步。provides long-horizon agentic trajectories, with some traces exceeding 2M tokens. These two datasets offer complementary challenges: TRAIL/SWE-bench is token-dense despite fewer steps, whereas TRAIL/GAIA contains the longest trajectories, peaking at 122 steps.

基线。Baselines. 一键提示One-shot Prompting。我们评估标准的长上下文 CoT 提示，其中整个轨迹被加载到模型的上下文窗口中，并对数据集论文中提供的提示进行了轻微修改. We evaluate standard long-context CoT prompting, where the entire trajectory is loaded into the model’s context window, with slight modification of prompts provided in the dataset paper(Zhang et al., 2025; Deshpande et al., 2025). 一步一步Step-by-step (Zhang et al., 2025)。该基线扩展了标准 LLM 判断，每次一步扫描轨迹，直到定位到故障。虽然很暴力，但这种方法有效地绕过了全局上下文限制，因为它只需要单个步骤，而不是整个历史记录，适合模型的可寻址内存。. This baseline extends the standard LLM judge by scanning the trajectory one step at a time until a failure is localized. While brute-force, this method effectively bypasses global context limits, as it only requires that a single step, rather than the entire history, fits within the model’s addressable memory.莱佛士RAFFLES (Zhu et al., 2026)。作为最先进的迭代基线，莱佛士采用多轮推理来完善归因。虽然有效，但它仍然局限于模型的本机上下文窗口。. As a state-of-the-art iterative baseline, RAFFLES employs multi-turn reasoning to refine attribution. While effective, it remains confined to the model’s native context window.

指标。Metrics.我们采用标准指标来进行决定性故障归因。我们报告步进精度We employ standard metrics for Decisive Fault Attribution. We report Step-level Accuracy(Zhang et al., 2025)以及公差精度 (alongside Tolerant Accuracy (±s\pm s步骤），这解释了人工注释过程中固有的歧义。由于 TRAIL 数据集标记了轨迹中的所有故障，但没有标记单个决定性故障，因此我们引入了两个专门的指标：steps), which accounts for inherent ambiguity in the human annotation process. Since the TRAIL dataset labels all of the faults in the trajectory but not a single decisive fault, we introduce two specialized metrics:精度Precision，它测量预测的步骤是否与任何地面真实故障一致，以及, which measures whether the predicted step aligns with any ground-truth fault, and严格的精度Strict Precision，它评估预测的决定性故障是否属于注释的高影响故障的子集。, which assesses whether the predicted decisive fault is among the subset of annotated high-impact faults.

比例因子Scaling Factorς\varsigma. 为了形式化长水平轨迹的评估，我们定义了一个比例因子To formalize the evaluation of long horizon traces, we define a scaling factorς=Posinfo/Lencontext\varsigma=\text{Pos}_{\text{info}}/\text{Len}_{\text{context}}, 其中, wherePosinfo\text{Pos}_{\text{info}}是根本原因故障的标记位置，is the token position of the root-cause fault andLencontext\text{Len}_{\text{context}}代表评估者的代币预算。虽然大多数故障归因方法通常在以下情况下有效：represents the evaluator’s token budget. While most fault attribution methods are generally effective whenς<1\varsigma<1，他们达到了上下文上限, they hit a context ceiling asς\varsigma接近或超过 1，导致目标信息落在可寻址内存之外或遭受灾难性的注意力稀释。approaches or exceeds 1, causing target information to fall outside addressable memory or suffer from catastrophic attention dilution.

我们使用 Claude-Opus-4.6（1M 代币）作为我们的主要骨干法学硕士。然而，现有的故障归因数据集存在结构性限制：90% 的故障发生在前 20 万个标记内（见表We use Claude-Opus-4.6 (1M-token) as our primary backbone LLM. However, existing fault attribution datasets present a structural limitation: 90% of faults occur within the first 200k tokens (see Table1），产生比例因子), yielding a scaling factor ofς≈0.2\varsigma\approx 0.2。为了充分评估长期能力. To adequately evaluate long-horizon capabilities whereς≥1\varsigma\geq 1，我们开发了两种评估方法：, we develop two evaluation methodologies:

固定上下文预算Fixed context budget：无论故障位置如何，我们都会在严格的令牌上限（例如 100k）下评估轨迹。 这可以评估系统在现实世界中的稳健性，更重要的是，当轨迹扩展到数百万个令牌范围，超出具有最长上下文限制的可用模型时，可以为系统性能建立可靠的预测。: We evaluate trajectories under a strict token ceiling (e.g., 100k) regardless of fault position. This assesses the system’s real-world robustness and, more importantly, establishes a reliable projection for system performance when the trajectories scale toward multi-million token horizons, beyond available models with the longest context limit.

固定比例因子Fixed scaling factor: 我们修复: We fixς\varsigma对于每次试验，并根据故障位置按比例调整模型的上下文长度。例如，要测试for each trial and adjust the model’s context length proportionally to the fault position. For example, to testς=2\varsigma=2对于 500k 令牌的错误，我们将 LLM 的上下文限制为 250k 令牌。这衡量了当信息超出上下文限制时诊断准确性如何扩展。for a fault at 500k tokens, we limit the LLM’s context to 250k tokens. This measures how diagnostic accuracy scales as information exceeds the context limit.

4 结果Results

固定预算绩效。Fixed Budget Performance.图Figure2(a)说明了 TRAIL (GAIA) 在不同固定上下文长度约束下的性能。在痕迹显着超出上下文限制（25k 代币预算）的情况下，illustrates performance on TRAIL (GAIA) under different fixed context length constraints. In the regimes where traces significantly exceed context limit (25k token budget),萨法里SAFARI在精度方面比 RAFFLES 高 7%，在严格精度方面比 RAFFLES 高 19%。这凸显了 Active Investigator 循环的功效：虽然基线在被截断时会遭受灾难性的信息丢失，outperforms RAFFLES by 7% in precision and 19% in strict precision. 鉴于这些发现，我们建议部署Given these findings, we recommend deploying萨法里SAFARI在轨迹超出主干法学硕士本地上下文窗口的环境中，或在一般预算受限的环境中。虽然我们当前的评估重点是离线性能，但附录中详细介绍了系统延迟相对于基线和未来工作方向的比较分析in environments characterized by trajectories that exceed the native context window of the backbone LLM, or for general budget-constrained environments. 5 结论Conclusion

我们介绍We introduce萨法里SAFARI，证明主动调查（选择性查询和推理轨迹段的能力）为故障归因的线性上下文摄取提供了强大的替代方案。结果表明, demonstrating that Active Investigation, the ability to selectively query and reason over trajectory segments, offers a robust alternative to linear context ingestion for fault attribution. Results show that萨法里SAFARI在 Who&When 基准（100 万代币预算）上比最先进的方法高出 20%，在 TRAIL GAIA（25K 代币预算有限）上比最先进的方法高出 19%。最重要的是，outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 20% on the Who&When benchmark (1M token budget) and by 19% on TRAIL GAIA (with constrained 25K token budget). Most significantly,萨法里SAFARI即使目标故障超出模型本机上下文窗口 5 倍，传统评估器会完全失败，但仍能保持 0.58 的精度。maintains a 0.58 precision even when the target fault resides 5x beyond the model’s native context window, a regime where traditional evaluators fail completely.

附录BAppendix B延迟分析Latency Analysis

如表所示As shown in Table5, 萨法里SAFARI表现出自适应延迟特性。在高资源状态（1M 令牌）中，它通过最大化检索吞吐量和并行证据验证来与基线速度融合。相反，在低预算场景（25k 代币）中，exhibits adaptive latency characteristics. In high-resource regimes (1M tokens), it converges with baseline speeds by maximizing retrieval throughput and parallelizing evidence verification. Conversely, in low-budget scenarios (25k tokens),萨法里SAFARI有意用延迟换取精度，采用迭代工具调用来综合不相交段的信息。这种自适应设计使系统能够在资源受限的环境中产生卓越的诊断结果，在这种环境中，传统模型由于上下文限制而完全失败。此外，在比较不同轨迹长度的数据集（GAIA 与 SWE）时，intentionally trades latency for precision, employing iterative tool calling to synthesize information across disjoint segments. This adaptive design enables the system to yield superior diagnostic results in resource-constrained environments where traditional models fail entirely due to context limits. Furthermore, when comparing datasets of varying trajectory lengths (GAIA vs. SWE),萨法里SAFARI演示了与现有方法一致的延迟扩展配置文件，确认主动调查的开销仍然与任务复杂性成正比。demonstrates a latency scaling profile consistent with existing methods, confirming that the overhead of Active Investigation remains proportional to task complexity.

If the some of the tool call observations were evicted due to limited context limit, the information would be lost unless the Investigator Agent decide to retrieve them again, wasting some available turn budgets. 如表所示As shown in Table6在 GAIA 子集上，STM 提高了所有代币预算。这表明短期记忆不仅仅是对被逐出的观察结果的简单总结；它充当逻辑锚点。通过持续不断的调查计划和诊断假设，STM 允许调查员代理对故障保持连贯的叙述，这是消融版本所缺乏的功能。on the GAIA subset, STM yields a lift across all token budgets. This suggests that the short-term memory as more than a simple summarization of the evicted observations; it serves as a logical anchor. By persisting investigation plans and diagnostic hypotheses across turns, the STM allows the Investigator Agent to maintain a coherent narrative of the failure, a capability the ablated version lacks.

对于 SWEBench，STM 的影响在较高预算（1M 和 200k）时不太明显，但在 100k 级别时变得显着。如表所示For SWEBench, the impact of the STM is less pronounced at higher budgets (1M and 200k) but becomes significant at the 100k level. As shown in Table1、TRAIL (SWEBench) 跟踪的步骤较少，但每个步骤的令牌密度都非常高。在这种情况下，系统必须在准确摘要和信息丢失之间进行权衡。, TRAIL (SWEBench) traces feature fewer steps, but each step is exceptionally token-dense. In this scenario, the system must navigate a trade-off between accurate summarization and information loss.

当上下文预算充足时，与存储在对话历史记录中的原始日志的效用相比，仅保留选定信息的好处是微乎其微的。然而，在低预算状态（100k）中，持久内存缓冲区的必要性超过了摘要损失的影响，从而允许When the context budget is ample, the benefits of persisting only selected information are marginal compared to the utility of the raw logs that are stored in the conversation history. However, in the low-budget regime (100k), the necessity of a persistent memory buffer outweighs the impact of summarization loss, allowing萨法里SAFARI比消融版本表现更好。to perform better than the ablated version.

未来还有几个领域需要探索。一个有希望的方向是评估Several frontiers remain for future exploration. One promising direction is to evaluate萨法里SAFARI超越故障归因的通用长期任务，以测试主动调查循环的普遍性。此外，我们的目标是将框架扩展到开放式推理和创造性合成等领域，其中错误是通过人类对齐和语义意图而不是二进制成功指标来定义的。on general-purpose long-horizon tasks beyond fault attribution to test the universality of the Active Investigation loop. Additionally, we aim to extend the framework to domains such as open-ended reasoning and creative synthesis, where errors are defined through human alignment and semantic intent rather than binary success metrics.

的The任务目标task_goal字段指定目标：识别特定文章的提名者。然后代理生成field specifies the objective: identifying the nominator of a specific article. The agent then generates the最终输出final_output底层系统以及有关潜在错误的推理块。值得注意的是，我们没有向 LLM 提供 GAIA 基本事实（“FunkMonk”）；该模型很可能在其开发阶段就记住了这些信息。这种记忆效应适用于我们提出的方法和所有基线方法。由于大多数公共数据集可能包含在预训练语料库中，因此减轻这种影响具有挑战性。of the underlying system alongside a reasoning block regarding potential errors. It is worth noting that we did not provide the LLM with the GAIA ground truth (”FunkMonk”); it is highly probable that the model memorized this information during its development phase. This memorization effect applies to both our proposed method and all baseline methods. Since most public datasets are likely included in pre-training corpora, mitigating this effect is challenging.

尽管如此，故障归因任务仍然是一个关键的研究领域。即使模型识别出最终输出是否正确，它本质上也不知道代理过程中的哪个特定步骤导致了错误。因此，未来的研究应该集中于使用私有或“封闭”数据集评估错误归因方法，以确保法学硕士之前没有遇到过底层任务的基本事实。Nevertheless, the task of fault attribution remains a critical area of study; even if a model recognizes whether a final output is correct, it does not inherently know which specific step in the agentic process led to an error. Consequently, future research should focus on evaluating fault attribution methods using private or ”closed” datasets to ensure the LLM has not previously encountered the ground truth of the underlying tasks.

上市ListingLABEL:lst:investigator-example-2说明了调查循环的后续迭代，展示了illustrates a subsequent iteration of the investigative loop, demonstrating萨法里SAFARI的稀疏更新机制。为了最大限度地提高效率并防止上下文漂移，代理仅发出需要修改的 STM 字段。在这种情况下，该模型确定了三个不同的调查差距：验证可疑的工具使用故障（代理可能打印了任务字符串而不是执行搜索工具），验证特定实体（“FunkMonk”）的真实值，以及分析后续步骤中的故障模式传播。因此，调查员代理启动有针对性的搜索，以确认搜索工具是否在轨迹内被正式调用。’s sparse update mechanism. To maximize efficiency and prevent context drift, the agent only emits the STM fields that require modification. In this instance, the model identifies three distinct investigative gaps: verifying a suspected tool-use failure (where the agent may have printed a task string rather than executing the search tool), validating the ground-truth value for a specific entity (”FunkMonk”), and analyzing the failure pattern propagation in subsequent steps. Consequently, the Investigator Agent initiates a targeted search to confirm whether the search tool was ever formally invoked within the trajectory.

在随后的评估阶段中，如图所示During the subsequent evaluation phase shown inLABEL:lst:investigator-example-3，调查员代理在步骤 3 中制定了三个有针对性的假设来验证候选故障。这些问题旨在确认： (a) 确定故障的存在； (b) 这是因果链中主要（最早）的失败； (c) 在整个轨迹的其余部分中，误差仍未得到纠正。评估小组分别返回了 75、92 和 92 分，超过了 70 分的平均受理阈值。因此，调查员代理被提示完成其提交。如迹线分析所示，步骤 3 确实被验证为 TRAIL (GAIA) 子集中的真实错误。, the Investigator Agent formulated three targeted hypotheses to validate the candidate fault at step 3. These questions were designed to confirm: (a) the existence of a definitive fault; (b) that this was the primary (earliest) failure in the causal chain; and (c) that the error remained uncorrected throughout the remainder of the trajectory. The evaluation ensemble returned scores of 75, 92, and 92, respectively, surpassing the admissibility average threshold of 70. Consequently, the Investigator Agent was prompted to finalize its submission. As shown in the trace analysis, step 3 was indeed verified as a ground-truth fault within the TRAIL (GAIA) subset.
